show.title: Kesari…aam bana khaas
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/FNZ7Lh
show.description: Kesari Barabanki is a humble mango seller whose life revolves around his son, Vayu. But behind his simple image, he is secretly a powerful tycoon known as the King of AAP Company. When Munna, the reckless son of his CEO, kidnaps and tortures Vayu for revenge, Kesari unleashes his wrath and destroys Munna’s family business. In the middle of this storm, Kesari meets the kind-hearted Vishakha, and love slowly heals his broken world, leading them to a heartfelt engagement.
